character-sheet.png:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: definitive mascot character reference sheet for an app; flat vector illustration.
Primary request: Design one sympathetic, cute, slightly mischievous RED PANDA COURIER who carries a short bamboo stick as a relay baton. Create a polished character model sheet that an SVG artist can reproduce with simple clean paths.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory plain background, generous space, no panel borders.
Subject: compact red panda with a broad soft triangular head, large triangular ears with cream interiors, persimmon russet crown, two small cream eyebrow patches, sweeping cream cheek patches and cream muzzle, dark chocolate oval eyes and tiny triangular nose; small stocky dark chocolate body and paws, russet shoulders, and a VERY BIG fluffy curved tail with broad alternating russet and deep burnt-orange stripes. Rounded shapes and clear silhouette. Tiny knowing smile; charming courier energy. No clothing or accessories except the bamboo baton.
Composition/framing: landscape model sheet. Top row: equally scaled full-body front sitting pose holding the bamboo baton with tail curled around feet; right-facing side walking pose with big raised curved striped tail; three-quarter standing view. Bottom row: curled asleep with tail as a blanket; three small head expressions (content, happy closed eyes, startled wide eyes); separate bamboo baton with two nodes and two simple leaves. Consistent exact same character and markings in every view, all fully visible and separated.
Style/medium: flat vector illustration, large clean shapes, smooth confident curves, very limited palette, no outlines except face details, no texture, no fur strands, no shadows or gradients. Friendly contemporary macOS app mascot, not photorealistic or 3D.
Color palette: persimmon #E8622C, deeper russet #C54819, dark chocolate #382820, warm cream #FAF3E8; bamboo muted jade green #668B57 with lighter nodes.
Constraints: No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, speech balloons, interface mockups, decorative scenery or extra characters. All facial markings and proportions must remain consistent across views.
